calculation.expression: where(cross_asset_mean(rolling_std(log_returns,5)) > rolling_quantile(cross_asset_mean(rolling_std(log_returns,5)),120,0.7), -rolling_sum(log_returns,3), rolling_sum(log_returns,20)/rolling_std(log_returns,20)); all components use completed data lagged one day
calculation.description: Uses risk-adjusted 20-day trend in normal dispersion and switches to three-day reversal during unusually high cross-asset dispersion. The trend branch penalizes assets with elevated recent volatility; the stress branch seeks rebounds after dislocations.

validation.regime_notes: Full synthetic cross-asset sample across 2020-02- through 2029-02-07, using all 15 tradable assets and at least 8 valid instruments per date. Small cross-section implies conservative IC uncertainty; signal has positive IC at all tested horizons.
